4.  **Nathan Price to Prof. Smith**: An editor at Academic Press reminds Professor Smith of the May 1st manuscript submission deadline for his book 'Daily Life in Ancient Thebes'.

It includes a suspicious footer asking the recipient to email 'contact@contact.com' with 'confirmation' to resolve a placeholder error ('$XX billion'), which appears to be a phishing attempt or scam.
7.  **Melissa Carter to Casey**: An invitation for Casey to speak on a marketing panel at TechCon regarding 'The Future of Digital Advertising in a Post-Cookie World' on May 15th, with travel and accommodation covered.
8.  **Rachel Kim to Casey**: An account manager at Digital AdWorks requests a performance analysis of an underperforming AdWords campaign for a health and wellness client to provide actionable insights.
